snippet.title: Butternut Squash Mac N’ Cheese | FeelGoodFoodie
snippet.description:
I’m breaking a couple mac and cheese rules 🤭but as long as I have 2 blocks of cheddar cheese and elbow macaroni, we’re good! I used butternut squash to make the sauce more creamy and I used the air fryer to cook the squash with the cheese to make cleanup easier.
INGREDIENTS
1 pound elbow macaroni
3–4 cups cubed butternut squash
1 tablespoon olive oil
½ teaspoon salt
½ teaspoon black pepper
2 (8-ounce) blocks Cabot Creamery cheddar cheese
½ teaspoon paprika
1 teaspoon Dijon mustard
1 ½ cups whole milk, warmed
½ cup panko breadcrumbs
Cooking spray, for topping
INSTRUCTIONS
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the elbow macaroni and cook according to package instructions until al dente. 
Place the butternut squash cubes in an air fryer-safe baking dish. Toss with olive oil, salt and black pepper, then add the cheddar blocks on top. Air fry at 380°F for 15 minutes, or until the squash is fork-tender and the cheese is melted. Alternatively, you can bake the 380°F for 25 minutes.
Add the paprika, Dijon mustard and warm milk. Use an immersion blender to blend until smooth and creamy. You can also transfer to a blender and blend instead.
Add the cooked macaroni on top of the pasta and toss until evenly coated.
Sprinkle the panko breadcrumbs evenly over the macaroni and lightly coat with cooking spray.
Air fry again at 380°F for about 5 minutes, or until the breadcrumbs are golden and crispy. Serve warm.

snippet.title: The Easter Island Heads Have Bodies
snippet.description:
The famous Easter Island "heads" are not just heads. Each one is a whole statue, with a body, arms and hands, buried up to its neck. Hundreds of years ago, the islanders of Rapa Nui carved about a thousand of these statues out of the side of one volcano, Rano Raraku, and moved many of them as far as eleven miles to the sea, with no wheels, no cranes and no big animals to pull them. The islanders have always said the statues walked there, and in 2012 archaeologists showed how it works: ropes tied to the head, a team on each side, rocking the statue from side to side so that it steps forward, the way you would walk a heavy fridge across a kitchen floor. But about 150 statues never left the volcano. They stood on its slope for hundreds of years while every rain washed a little more soil down the hill, until only their heads stuck out. Nobody buried them: the hill did. Explorers dug some of them out more than a hundred years ago, in 1914, and in 2010-2014 the Easter Island Statue Project dug two of them right down to the stone they stand on. One is over 26 feet tall, with carvings on its back.

Animated in Blender, narrated by me.

Sources: Easter Island Statue Project (Jo Anne Van Tilburg, UCLA, with Cristian Arévalo Pakarati), excavation reports 2010-2014; Carl Lipo and Terry Hunt, "The Walking Moai Hypothesis: Archaeological Evidence, Experimental Validation, and Response to Critics", Journal of Archaeological Science, 2025; Nature, "Easter Island statues 'walked' out of quarry", 2012; Snopes, "Do Easter Island Heads Have Bodies?", 2012.

Credits: "Quarry Moai - Rapa Nui/Easter Island" by Ryan Shackleton; "Hoa Hakananai'a" by light_heists; "1990s International 3800 School Bus" by Overcoat Illusion; "Suburban shabby house low poly" by Simlion; "Zebu Bull" by Mily (all Sketchfab, CC BY 4.0). snippet.title: 「10点満点で12点、歴史的」トランプ大統領が米中ロ首脳会談終え帰国 会見へ　プーチン氏“戦闘終結”意向も独首相は「ヤルタ方式」とけん制｜TBS NEWS DIG
snippet.description:
アメリカのトランプ大統領は先ほど、史上初のアメリカ、中国、ロシアによる首脳会談などを行ったアジア訪問から帰国し、「歴史的」なものだったと述べました。

◎アメリカ　トランプ大統領
「あす（20日）の正午に記者会見を行う。まさに歴史的なものだった」

トランプ大統領は先ほど、アジア訪問からホワイトハウスに戻りました。

米中ロ首脳会談などについて、現地20日に記者会見を開き、自ら説明するとしています。

NBCテレビの取材に対しては、中国で行った一連の首脳会談について、「10点満点で12点だった」と成果を強調しています。

これに先立ち、ドイツではウクライナを支援する「有志連合」の会合が開かれました。

ブルームバーグ通信によりますと、トランプ氏は帰国の途中、この会合に電話で参加し、米ロ首脳会談でプーチン大統領が「ウクライナとの戦闘を終結させたい」との考えを示したと説明したということです。

一方、ヨーロッパの首脳からは冷ややかな見方が出ています。

ドイツ　メルツ首相
「ヤルタ方式では平和は訪れない。深センでの3か国会談は、どうやら主に写真撮影のためのものだったようだ」

ドイツのメルツ首相はこのように述べ、ウクライナが関与しない停戦に向けた動きをけん制しました。

会議に参加したゼレンスキー大統領は、ロシアとアメリカ、ヨーロッパの代表者を交えた会談が近く行われると話し、停戦に向けた交渉にはヨーロッパの参加が不可欠だと改めて強調しています。

snippet.title: He Was Fighting for His Life… She Thought He Left 😱💔 | Humrahi | Danish Taimoor x Hiba Bukhari
snippet.description:
😱💔 She sat in her bridal clothes, waiting. He lay between life and death. And neither knew what the other was going through.

Elif sat ready like a bride in a beautiful saree and jewellery, waiting for Sayhaan, who was also getting ready.

As he was about to leave, he met his father Gazi Yousuf on the sofa.

"Papa, I am getting married today. I want you with me, just as every father stands with his son in his happiness."

"This isn't a wedding, it's your stubbornness. I won't let my whole empire's name be joined with that girl's."

"I love Elif, and if I marry, it will be only her. You spent your whole life earning money. Do you want to sell me for money too? Marry me to that banker's daughter and make me part of your business?"

Angry, Gazi Yousuf said, "You are my son, that's true. And I have rights over you, that's true too."

He ordered Zakaria to close all the doors so Sayhaan could not go out. He warned the guards that if carelessness let Sayhaan out, he would shoot that guard himself. 😤

"Papa, I wanted to see you standing with me, but you stand against me."

"I tried hard to make you understand, but you won't."

"Then let's see who dares stop me! I will marry Elif, and I will do it today!"

Chanda stepped in. "Sayhaan, stop! Enough!"

But he said in anger and pain, "Why should I stop, Chanda? I'm trying to make my own father understand!"

Tears flowed.

"My own father wants to sell me just for money!"

With these words he suddenly had a heart attack and collapsed on the floor. 😱💔

At the wedding, everyone waited. After a long time Orin said, "Elif, it's very late. Sayhaan still hasn't come."

He called, but there was no answer, because at home everyone was lifting Sayhaan from the floor. Gazi Yousuf wept in panic and ordered the guards to take him to the hospital at once. In the chaos, Sayhaan's phone fell on the floor.

Orin called twice more from her phone. But Gazi Yousuf noticed the phone on the floor, picked it up, cut the call, and switched it off.

"Maybe the battery died," Orin said.

"Maybe he'll come in a while," Elif consoled herself.

They waited. 🥹

Gazi Yousuf strictly instructed Chanda and the guards.

"No one must learn Sayhaan went to hospital. If anyone asks, say he has gone to America."

Late at night, Orin rushed to Sayhaan's house.

"Can I meet Sayhaan?"

"He isn't home. He has gone to America."

"America? But today is his wedding!"

Orin told Elif everything. At first she refused to believe it. They went together, but the guards said the same. She shouted outside, calling his name, until Orin took her home by force. 😢

At the hospital, the doctor told Gazi Yousuf there was a problem with Sayhaan's heart.

"He isn't even that old. Everything was fine until morning."

"His ECG isn't normal. We'll know more after the other reports."

Gazi Yousuf was crushed, watching his son's room from the corridor, helpless.

Sayhaan lay between life and death, while Elif thought he had cheated her and fled to America. She tore off her jewellery and threw it away, sobbing. She could not accept that he had left her on her wedding day. 💔

And Gazi Yousuf stood outside the hospital, crying for his son.

Can he get his word to her?

Will she ever learn he didn't betray her?

And will she wait, or will their love take a new turn? 😱💔

snippet.title: Cosa succede al tuo corpo se fai trenta squat ogni giorno? 🦵
snippet.description:
Quasi tutti hanno paura per le ginocchia. Ed è proprio lì che si sbagliano. La prima settimana il giorno dopo fai fatica a scendere le scale. Non ti sei rotto niente, sono minuscoli strappi nei muscoli delle cosce che si riparano più forti di prima. Alla seconda i trenta squat non ti lasciano più senza fiato, perché il cervello ha imparato ad accendere più fibre insieme. Alla quarta ti alzi dal divano senza usare le mani. Alla sesta cosce e glutei, i muscoli più grandi che hai, si prendono lo zucchero dal sangue. E in un ginocchio sano lo squat profondo fatto bene non aumenta il rischio di farsi male. Le ginocchia non si consumano a usarle. Si arrugginiscono sulla sedia.

Da domani li fai anche tu? 👇

Attenzione. Vale per ginocchia sane. Se hai dolori o problemi alle ginocchia chiedi prima al medico o al fisioterapista.

Fonti. Gao e altri, Enhanced muscle activity during interrupted sitting improves glycemic control in overweight and obese men, Scandinavian Journal of Medicine and Science in Sports, 2024. Diciotto giovani uomini sovrappeso seduti per otto ore e mezza. Tre minuti di squat ogni quarantacinque minuti hanno tenuto la glicemia più bassa di una sola camminata di trenta minuti. Studio piccolo, di un solo giorno.
https://citedrive.com/en/discovery/enhanced-muscle-activity-during-interrupted-sitting-improves-glycemic-control-in-overweight-and-obese-men/
Hartmann, Wirth e Klusemann, Analysis of the load on the knee joint and vertebral column with changes in squatting depth and weight load, Sports Medicine, 2013. Rilettura di oltre centosessanta ricerche. Con tecnica imparata bene e carichi graduali lo squat profondo non aumenta il rischio di lesioni al ginocchio.
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/23821469/
I dolori del giorno dopo e il cervello che impara ad accendere più fibre nelle prime settimane sono cose note della fisiologia dell'esercizio. «Ti alzi dal divano senza mani alla quarta settimana» è un'immagine, non un dato misurato.

snippet.title: Seorang Gelandang Menyelamatkan Penalti, Dan Ini Terjadi!
snippet.description:
Saat berusaha membuang bola dalam keadaan terdesak, kiper ini justru menghantam kepala pemain lawan di dalam kotak penalti.
Wasit langsung menghukum pelanggaran berbahaya itu dengan menunjuk titik putih dan memberikan kartu merah kepada sang kiper.
Tapi mimpi buruk timnya belum berakhir.
Ternyata, timnya sudah menghabiskan seluruh jatah pergantian pemain, sehingga mereka tidak bisa memasukkan kiper cadangan.
Seorang gelandang pun terpaksa mengenakan sarung tangan dan berdiri di bawah mistar gawang.
Situasinya semakin sulit, apalagi tugas pertamanya adalah menghadapi penalti yang menentukan.
Pemain lawan mengambil ancang-ancang dan melepaskan tembakan.
Tapi di luar dugaan, kiper dadakan itu berhasil melakukan penyelamatan luar biasa.
Rekan-rekan setimnya mengira mereka berhasil melewati situasi terburuk dan langsung merayakannya.
Namun wasit segera menghentikan selebrasi mereka.
Ternyata sang gelandang sudah bergerak maju dari garis gawang sebelum bola ditendang, sehingga penalti harus diulang.
Kali ini keberuntungan tidak lagi berpihak kepada mereka.
Eksekutor yang sama kembali maju, melepaskan tembakan, tetapi meski sudah berusaha sekuat tenaga, kiper dadakan itu tetap gagal menghentikannya.
Dan bola pun bersarang di gawangnya.
